```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- "Selected PPA formulations by response, with retained iteration, number of OOF pairs, $R^2$, and RMSE in the modelling and physical domains."
}
DATASET <- "QDS"
METHOD <- "ensemble.RMSE"
FAMILY <- "^ppa([LTV])?$"
.MODEL_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
RESPONSES <- as.character(.MODEL_CONFIG$responses$names)
RESPONSES <- RESPONSES[grepl(FAMILY, RESPONSES)]
PathSummary <- file.path(root, "data", "summary")
PathIter <- file.path(root, "data", "iter")
UNITS <- unlist(jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)["ppa"])
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demand-ppa-metrics
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "performance.R"))
TBL
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, DATASET, FAMILY, METHOD, PathIter, PathSummary, RESPONSES, UNITS,
   .MODEL_CONFIG)
```
